core_equation.ETc: crop evapotranspiration / crop water need, mm per time unit
core_equation.ETo: reference evapotranspiration, mm per same time unit

required_rule: Kc must be crop- and stage-specific; do not invent Kc values.
standard_conditions_note: FAO 56 standard ETc assumes no limiting water, salinity, density, pest, disease, weed or fertility conditions.
engine_requirements: separate verified Kc data from live weather
do not present exact irrigation runtime unless emitter flow/efficiency and irrigated area are known
weather provider absence must block live-weather claims
